superwasp.evidence: TRAPPIST i+z viewed a partial transit, but it was v-shaped and deep enough to suggest a grazing EB
2xIDS shows SB1, possible hint of a second peak
Tenagra i-band shows transit from the target, but further observations with Mercator shows there are two stars and the transit is likely on the faint closeby companion
OHP/SOPHIE ccf shows fast rotating binary, SOPHIE shows it is an SB2
INT/IDS shows this is two stars spatially separated
5 SOPHIE observations show large variations not in phase with .5 day period
9xSOPHIE show no significant variation, NITES shows 1.5% eclipse; but updated Gaia dr2 radius kills it
7xSOPHIE RVs show linear drift and additional variations not in phase
8xSOPHIE RVs show this is an SB1
4xCORALIE shows long quadratic drift, but star is a visual binary; TRAPPIST i+z observed partial transit
